ts_real_day_ok.intent: executed_at on a real leap day (2024-02-29) inside the window; accepted

ts_fraction_truncation_ok.intent: window .1234-.9876, executed .1239: milliseconds compared, extra digits truncated; accepted

ts_impossible_day.intent: executed_at = '2026-02-30T00:30:00Z': not a real instant, refused

ts_hour_24.intent: executed_at = '2026-10-04T24:00:00Z': not a real instant, refused

ts_second_60.intent: executed_at = '2026-10-04T00:30:60Z': not a real instant, refused

ts_year_zero.intent: executed_at = '0000-10-04T00:30:00Z': not a real instant, refused

ts_trailing_newline.intent: executed_at = '2026-10-04T00:30:00Z\n': not a real instant, refused

ts_lowercase_tz.intent: executed_at = '2026-10-04t00:30:00z': not a real instant, refused

ts_offset.intent: executed_at = '2026-10-04T00:30:00+00:00': not a real instant, refused

prev_absent_seq0.intent: seq 0 with prev_evidence_id absent (not null): root_prev_not_null

seq_not_integer.intent: hop.seq is the string "0": a JSON integer is required, seq_gap

seq_duplicate_same_verdict.intent: two witnesses at seq 0, same verdict: distinct seqs 0,1 are contiguous, no disagreement; accepted

verdict_missing_is_distinct.intent: one observation at seq 0 carries no conduct.verdict: that counts as a distinct value of its own, witness_disagreement

evidence_empty_object.intent: outcome.evidence = {}: present and not well formed, evidence_invalid

evidence_empty_array.intent: outcome.evidence = []: present and not well formed, evidence_invalid

evidence_zero.intent: outcome.evidence = 0: absent by the falsy rule, no_evidence_bound

outcome_not_object.intent: outcome is a string: E is absent, no_evidence_bound

require_signatures_zero.intent: require_signatures = 0 (a number, not the literal false) with a signature that does not verify: checks still run

require_signatures_false.intent: require_signatures = false with the same bad encoding: checks are off, the bundle is accepted

unknown_bundle_keys.intent: unknown bundle keys are ignored; accepted

sig_missing_padding.intent: provider_sig with padding removed: not canonical standard base64, refused

sig_urlsafe_alphabet.intent: provider_sig with + and / rewritten as - and _: not canonical standard base64, refused

sig_whitespace.intent: provider_sig with one character replaced by a space: not canonical standard base64, refused

sig_trailing_newline.intent: provider_sig with a newline appended: not canonical standard base64, refused

sig_noncanonical_trailing_bits.intent: provider_sig with unused trailing bits of the final quantum set: not canonical standard base64, refused

obs_element_not_object.intent: OPEN: observations = [1]. Proposal: a non-object element fails as an observation (delegation_observation_invalid) and contributes nothing to step 0 or R3/R4

obs_nonobject_with_valid.intent: OPEN: a non-object element next to a valid observation. Same proposal: one delegation_observation_invalid, the valid set verdicts as usual

receipts_element_not_object.intent: Malformed records: a receipts element that is not an object adds execution_invalid and does not enter the receipt set, so the grant has no receipts: execution_incomplete_pair

receipt_key_not_object.intent: Malformed records: receipt = 5 adds execution_invalid and is not presented, so receipts[0] is the primary and step 4 still runs

grant_key_not_object.intent: Malformed records: grant = "g" adds execution_invalid and is not presented, so the receipt set has no grant: execution_incomplete_pair

intent_key_not_object.intent: Malformed records: intent = 5 adds preflight_invalid and is not presented, so step 3 runs as if the slot were null

key_identity_small_order.intent: section 5 key rule: a did:key naming the identity point does not resolve, so the forged provider_sig (R = identity, S = 0) does not verify: execution_signature_invalid. OpenSSL accepts that signature

key_identity_noncanonical_signbit.intent: section 5 key rule: the same forgery under the same key with the sign bit set, which is neither canonical (x = 0 with the sign bit set) nor prime order. OpenSSL accepts the signature; the key must not resolve

key_order8_small_order.intent: section 5 key rule: a did:key naming a point of order 8 does not resolve, so the forged provider_sig (R = identity, S = 0, the receipt ground over 17 instants so that [k]T is the identity) does not verify: execution_signature_invalid. OpenSSL accepts it, and a verifier without the rule accepts the bundle

key_mixed_order.intent: section 5 key rule (R1): a did:key naming A + T, a mixed-order point. The holder of A's private key signed this receipt as A + T (0 instants ground so that [k]T is the identity), so one key poses as a second, independent party. The key must not resolve: execution_signature_invalid
